description: Assesses Cosmos’s continuing influence, separating estimates of audience reach from evidence of learning and comparing public television with later commercial revivals. Asks how scientific storytelling can represent collective knowledge, uncertainty, political differences and audience participation without making a presenter’s charisma a substitute for evidence.
